scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/build/index.html')) { console.log('✅ Client production build ready!'); } else { console.log('Building client...'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
